summary: Restores the readiness-record half of CHALLENGE-ADMISSION-01 that was split out of #473 and is not on main, because GitHub marked #458 merged when its head became an ancestor of main through the split. This PR moves the four readiness records to schema carbon.challenge-readiness.v3 with admission_tests, adds the record.py launch gate (a launch-approved record with admission blockers is refused) and --require-admission, restores the record and CLI tests, and regenerates the six Workbench files whose catalogue pins those record digests. The files are byte-identical to #458's head 0e1e25c9. It is HELD for the next Ask Carbon release candidate: the regenerated Pilot Designer page (sha256 85a46875) differs from the digest main's release candidate pins, so the bundle-guard test fails until a candidate carries it. No record is launch-approved, launch approval stays human-reserved, and no qualification or LIVE state changes.
